title: VOXL Studio evidence review
purpose: Judge captured browser evidence independently from implementation and deterministic test results.

ratingScale.pass: All required evidence supports the criterion with no material defect.
ratingScale.fail: Evidence shows a defect, contradicts the criterion, or is missing for a required criterion.
ratingScale.needs-review: Evidence is present but ambiguous; a human or a more focused journey must decide.

automaticFailureConditions: Any uncaught page error, unhandled rejection, or console error during a required step.
Any failed same-origin request required by the journey.
Any required step that did not complete or lacks its promised artifact.
Any public product text or exported filename that names a target game or implies affiliation with one.
Any required download that is empty, has an unexpected filename, or fails deterministic format validation.

criteria.title: Runtime integrity
criteria.pass: There are no uncaught errors, unexpected console errors, or required-request failures, and all required steps pass.

criteria.title: Target-neutral product language
criteria.pass: Visible product language and filenames use VOXL visual/profile terms only and contain no target-game brands or affiliation claims.

criteria.title: Pixel sharpness
criteria.pass: Atlas, motion pixels, mini previews, and 3D textures have hard pixel edges with no smoothing, bleeding, half-pixel seams, or blurry scaling.

criteria.title: Cuboid face orientation
criteria.pass: Head, torso, arms, and legs show the correct front, back, left, right, top, and bottom atlas faces without mirroring, inversion, or part swaps.

criteria.title: Outer-layer rendering
criteria.pass: Outer geometry is visibly separated from base geometry, transparent texels reveal the base, toggling it does not mutate document pixels, and hidden outer pixels cannot obscure base editing.

criteria.title: Wide and slim profiles
criteria.pass: Wide arms render at four units, slim arms at three units, both remain centered and correctly textured, conversion preserves valid shared regions, and exported atlases remain 64 by 64.

criteria.title: 2D and 3D synchronization
criteria.pass: A mapped 2D edit appears on the corresponding 3D surface, a 3D click changes the corresponding atlas texel, color picking agrees across views, and undo reverts the shared document.

criteria.title: Accessible controls and status
criteria.pass: Interactive controls have stable accessible names, form fields are labelled, status feedback is perceivable, and the journey does not rely on pointer-only access except where the canvas interaction itself is under test.

criteria.title: Responsive layout
criteria.pass: At both viewports the engine switcher, editor, inspectors, canvas, and primary actions remain visible or intentionally scrollable without overlap, clipping, or off-screen traps.

criteria.title: Download integrity
criteria.pass: Every expected file downloads once with the specified target-neutral name, is non-empty, decodes successfully, has expected dimensions, and preserves transparency where the format requires it.

criteria.title: Import validation boundary
criteria.pass: A valid 64 by 64 PNG loads and detects its profile; wrong dimensions, unreadable data, and invalid transparent base pixels are rejected with actionable messages and without corrupting the current draft.

reviewOutput.rule: A run passes only when every required criterion applicable to its journey is rated pass and no automatic failure condition is present.
